categories.main_business_segments: Fulin Plastic Industry primarily operates in the manufacturing of plastic products, focusing on PVC, PU, and TPU materials. The company segments its business into PVC products, plastic sheets, PU/TPU products, and other related plastic materials. It also engages in the production of specialty plastic products for various applications including automotive and consumer goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced plastic extrusion and molding technologies, specializing in PVC, PU, and TPU processing. It employs proprietary formulations and manufacturing techniques to produce high-quality plastic sheets and films. The production methods emphasize environmental compliance and innovation in material properties, including the development of eco-friendly and high-performance plastics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fulin serves a diverse customer base including automotive manufacturers, consumer electronics companies, and industrial product manufacturers. Its products are used in sectors such as automotive interiors, household appliances, and packaging. The company targets both domestic and international markets, supplying to well-known brands and OEMs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and Vietnam, with manufacturing facilities located in Hai Phong and Dong Nai, Vietnam. It serves customers across Asia and exports products globally, leveraging free trade agreements and foreign direct investment to expand its market reach. The Cayman Islands entity serves as a holding company for international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fulin operates mainly in the midstream segment of the plastic manufacturing supply chain, producing intermediate plastic materials and components. It sources raw materials upstream and supplies finished plastic sheets and films downstream to OEMs and brand manufacturers. The company integrates R&D and production to maintain control over product quality and innovation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in developing environmentally friendly and high-performance plastic materials, including innovations in PVC, PU, and TPU formulations. It focuses on expanding product applications in automotive and consumer sectors, enhancing sustainability, and complying with international environmental standards. Strategic initiatives include improving production efficiency and expanding capacity in Vietnam.
categories.revenue_model: Fulin generates revenue primarily through the sale of plastic products including PVC sheets, PU/TPU materials, and specialty plastic components. Revenue streams come from direct product sales to industrial customers and OEMs. The company also benefits from export sales and leverages its manufacturing scale to maintain competitive pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fulin competes with other plastic manufacturers specializing in PVC and PU/TPU products, including regional and global players in the plastic materials industry. It positions itself as a quality-focused and innovative supplier with strong manufacturing capabilities in Vietnam and Taiwan. The company emphasizes product differentiation through technology and environmental compliance to maintain market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Fulin reported revenues of approximately NT$2.79 billion, representing an 11% growth over the previous year. Operating income and net profit also showed double-digit growth, reflecting strong operational performance. The company has demonstrated steady expansion in production capacity and market penetration, with a focus on sustainable growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fulin offers high-quality, environmentally compliant plastic products with advanced material properties tailored for automotive and consumer applications. Its competitive differentiation lies in proprietary technology, sustainable manufacturing practices, and strategic geographic presence in Vietnam and Taiwan. The company provides reliable supply, customization capabilities, and innovation to meet evolving customer needs.
